name: Carbink

attacks.name: Glittering Gift
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, take a {Psychic} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to that Pokémon.

flavor:
It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s
a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering
Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.
